## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; mixed internals with Utilities/Energy outpacing Technology and Financials. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5); style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: CEG (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +14.22%) ABOVE TREND, SO (1W: +5.36% | 1M: +9.66%) ABOVE TREND, XEL (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +10.33%) ABOVE TREND. Materials/Energy also notable: FCX (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +12.51%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.13% | 1M: +15.98%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Financials weak: JPM (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +0.75%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -4.52%) BELOW TREND, AXP (1W: -5.53% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND. Technology and Industrials show pockets of weakness: ORCL (1W: -5.30% | 1M: -18.94%) BELOW TREND, IBM (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -19.38%) BELOW TREND, while CAT (1W: +1.95% | 1M: +20.55%) ABOVE TREND is an exception.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PYPL (1W: +14.16% | 1M: -16.40%) RECOVERY, CEG (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +14.22%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +12.51%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.13% | 1M: +15.98%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +7.08% | 1M: +23.78%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership concentration: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NUE (1W: -4.91% | 1M: -1.23%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -21.38%) BELOW TREND, MET (1W: -4.94% | 1M: -1.71%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -4.94% | 1M: +6.53%) CORRECTION, ORCL (1W: -5.30% | 1M: -18.94%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select Technology and Financial names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strong 1W movers: PYPL (1W: +14.16% | 1M: -16.40%) RECOVERY, CEG (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +14.22%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +12.51%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR DIVERGENCE among mega-cap techs (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META) with 1W up but 1M down — tactical risk, watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with pockets of strength but many short-term bounces; NVDA (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND, while MSFT (1W: +0.48% | 1M: -14.62%) RECOVERY and ORCL (1W: -5.30% | 1M: -18.94%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -0.25% — internal rotation and headline sensitivity.

8. Financials Outlook?
Cautious: JPM (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +0.75%) CORRECTION and V (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -4.52%) BELOW TREND, while PYPL (1W: +14.16% | 1M: -16.40%) RECOVERY shows idiosyncratic strength. Sector 1W: -1.28% — breadth weak, monitor earnings/policy headlines.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed defensives with selective strength; JNJ (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +10.69%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -1.39% | 1M: -19.18%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: +0.81% | 1M: -3.03%) RECOVERY. Sector 1W: +0.01% — nominally flat, watch biotech/regulatory catalysts.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain neutral positioning and favor pockets of defensive cyclicals and energy/utilities: CEG (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +14.22%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.13% | 1M: +15.98%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +1.95% | 1M: +20.55%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to structurally weak large-cap tech names showing sustained 1M weakness such as ACN (1W: -14.36% | 1M: -31.78%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -5.30% | 1M: -18.94%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PYPL (1W: +14.16% | 1M: -16.40%) RECOVERY on takeover chatter (+85 sentiment), FCX (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +12.51%) ABOVE TREND on operating-rights news, NVDA (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND on earnings beat chatter. BEARISH: AMZN (1W: +2.86% | 1M: -11.65%) RECOVERY but negative antitrust headlines (-60) creating risk, ACN (1W: -14.36% | 1M: -31.78%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -3.59% | 1M: -7.27%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities (1W: +3.95%) and Energy (1W: +0.43%) given strong headlines and policy flows. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.25%) and Financials (1W: -1.28%) given mixed mega-cap divergences and weak financial breadth.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Monitor whether mega-cap techs flip 1M momentum positive to confirm broader risk tilt (MSFT (1W: +0.48% | 1M: -14.62%) RECOVERY). Watch PYPL follow-through above this week’s range to validate takeover-driven RECOVERY (1W: +14.16% | 1M: -16.40%). Track AMAT (1W: +7.08% | 1M: +23.78%) holding ABOVE TREND for tech leadership confirmation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PYPL (+85): PayPal takeover chatter; price RECOVERY (1W: +14.16% | 1M: -16.40%) — sentiment diverging from weak 1M. CEG (+75): large energy loan headline; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +14.22%) — sentiment confirmed. FCX (+75): Grasberg rights extension; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +12.51%) — sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMZN (-60): antitrust headline; price RECOVERY (1W: +2.86% | 1M: -11.65%) — bearish news but short-term price strength is a divergence. BA (-50): safety/legal pressure; price BELOW TREND (1W: -3.59% | 1M: -7.27%) — sentiment confirmed. PFE (-45): analyst caution; price CORRECTION (1W: -1.02% | 1M: +4.68%) — mixed signals, watch upcoming catalysts.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. CEG (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +14.22%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +12.51%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +7.08% | 1M: +23.78%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: major divergence among mega-cap techs (MSFT RECOVERY, GOOGL RECOVERY, AMZN RECOVERY) and idiosyncratic news (PYPL +85) require confirmation before shifting stance.
